min_notional_preflight: Design section 8, "frozen test record uses `min_notional=101" and Design section 22.4, "multiplier `1`, `use_sl=true`, `use_sl_atr=false`, `use_sl_percent=true`, `use_sl_swing_atr=false`, `sl_percent=10`, `use_break_even=false`, `use_trailing=false" - the LEGACY runtime carries instrument_min_notional 0 while the corrected frozen InstrumentRecord carries minimum_notional 101. Order notional 1 * 100 * 1 = 100. Corrected admits iff 100 >= 101, which is false, so the corrected adapter refuses REFUSED_MIN_NOTIONAL and opens no position; the legacy strict comparison 100 < 0 is false, so legacy opens. Both thresholds are now explicit scenario inputs at Design section 22.4, "multiplier `1`, `use_sl=true`, `use_sl_atr=false`, `use_sl_percent=true`, `use_sl_swing_atr=false`, `sl_percent=10`, `use_break_even=false`, `use_trailing=false`, `tp_mode=" rather than prose-only values.
